description:
Real-world preparedness for people who don't buy the hype.

I'm Zach. I've been prepping for over a decade, not for the zombie apocalypse, but for the stuff that actually happens: blackouts, grocery shortages, hurricanes, wildfires, inflation, job loss, and the everyday chaos that catches most people with their pants down.

On this channel, you'll get practical, no-nonsense advice grounded in real history and real events, not fear, not gear-obsession, not prepper cosplay. I'll show you what to stockpile, what to skip, how to protect your home and family, and how to stay calm and capable when everyone else is panicking.

If you're tired of fluff listicles and influencers trying to sell you $300 bug-out bags, you're in the right place.
📩 Grab my free 50 Dollar Food Plan: https://zachofalltrades.io/freeplan/

🔔 Subscribe and hit the bell — new videos every week.

For business inquiries: zachprepperrecovery@proton.me
